_comment: The voice-activity model of whisper.cpp (Silero VAD v5.1.2, ggml format, MIT licence, repository ggml-org/whisper-vad). Same shape and rules as models.json. Pinned to a commit; sha256 and bytes read from the repository's LFS pointer file and checked against a download on Nov 3, 2026. Never bundled and never downloaded without the user asking. A second file in the same repository, ggml-silero-v6.2.0.bin (same size, sha256 2aa269b785eeb53a82983a20501ddf7c1d9c48e33ab63a41391ac6c9f7fb6987), exists; it is not offered.

models.label: Silero voice activity (small)
models.hint: Finds where people speak so the transcription can skip noise. 0.9 MB.
